candidates.change_summary: Deploy the EmergencyOracle with jojoTeam as the owner instead of msg.sender, changing the observable owner() of the new oracle.
Remove the NewEmergencyOracle event emission, so callers no longer observe the new oracle address via the event.
Deploy the EmergencyOracle with tx.origin as the owner instead of msg.sender, changing the observable owner() when called through an intermediary.
Invert the access-control check so only callers that are NOT the JOJO team may create oracles, changing who can call the target function.
